name: Forbidden Rites
description: Forbidden Rites event league (Path of Exile 2 0.5.5): 8 new challenges and exclusive rewards. Launching September 4 with patch 0.5.5, the event runs until the 1.0 Full Release on December 11.

name: Path of Exile 2 1.0 Full Release
description: Path of Exile 2 leaves Early Access and releases as a free-to-play game: complete six-Act campaign with Acts 5 and 6, the Shadow and Duelist classes, and the Conquerors of Wraeclast Challenge League (build a mercenary army, grow a stronghold, siege castles, automate your Atlas).
